name: How long does wall insulation installation take?
description: Installation time depends on project scope, insulation type, and home size. A retrofit might take 1-3 days; new construction or spray foam can take longer.

mainEntity.name: How long does wall insulation installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of wall insulation installation depends significantly on the project's scope, the type of insulation being installed, and the size and accessibility of your home. A typical retrofit project for an average-sized home, involving blowing insulation into existing wall cavities, might take 1-3 days. For new construction or comprehensive spray foam applications, the process could extend over several days to a week. Your contractor can provide a more precise timeline after assessing your specific property and project requirements.
